# Method: isKeyPressed()

```ts
isKeyPressed(key): boolean;
```

Check whether a key is currently pressed.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `key` | `string` | The key to check (e.g., 'a', 'Enter', 'ArrowLeft') |

## Returns

`boolean`

`true` when the key is currently pressed.
